volume.description: Path to the BitLocker-encrypted volume file or device (required)

bek_file.description: Path to the BitLocker Encryption Key (BEK) file (used with 'bekfile' method)

user_password.description: User password for decryption (used with 'user_password' method); omit to prompt interactively

recovery_password.description: Recovery password for decryption (used with 'recovery_password' method); omit to prompt interactively

fvek_file.description: Path to the FVEK file (used with 'fvek' method)

vmk_file.description: Path to the VMK file (used with 'vmk' method)

offset.description: Partition offset in bytes (default 0); base-10 integer

force_block.description: Force metadata block number (1, 2, or 3); boolean 'true' forces first block; omit to auto-detect

stateok.description: Skip volume state check (do not use unless you know the implications)

verbosity.description: Verbosity level (positive integer); each increment adds '-v'

mount_point.description: Mount point for the decrypted NTFS volume (required as final FUSE argument)
